project.name: Pacific Biochar Project design document Humboldt Sawmill Company (HSC)
project.description: Pacific Biochar specializes in the production and distribution of high-quality biochar products designed to sequester carbon while enhancing agricultural and industrial productivity. Pacific Biochar utilizes existing biomass power plant infrastructure to produce biochar, enabling rapid scaling potential with low capital investments.
ownership_evidence: Pacific Biochar Project design document Humboldt Sawmill Company (HSC)
Isometric Letter attesting to sustainability Pacific Humboldt feedstocks

feedstock.biomass_type: Forestry residues and downstream processing residues (primarily sawmill residue not fit for use in building materials)
feedstock.pre_project_biomass_use: Combusted as fuel for energy generation

production.system_description: The biochar production is integrated into an existing biomass cogeneration facility, which generates renewable biomass energy while minimizing waste.

monitoring_reporting.uncertainty_method: Conservative values for all measured parameters and laboratory analysis; +20% value changes applied to all sources of emissions to test sensitivity.
